evals.prompt: run a full pre-launch check on this repo — is the marketing site ready to ship? give me the release readiness report
evals.expected_output: Read-only audit across KB, design, code, security, SEO, analytics, a11y/perf, browser, tests, build gate; merged Blocker/Should-fix/Nice-to-have report with file:line + fixes + evidence and a GO/NO-GO verdict.
assertions: Report has an explicit GO or NO-GO verdict
Findings are grouped into Blocker / Should-fix / Nice-to-have (or equivalent 3-tier severity)
Most findings cite a file:line location
Most findings include a concrete code-level fix
lint, format:check and build were actually run and their results reported
Playwright suite was run (at least one project) and the pass/fail count reported
CSP allowlist was checked against external hosts used in src/
OG/Twitter defaults spread (shallow-merge trap) was checked across routes
Pre-existing 'Known inconsistencies' from CLAUDE.md are labelled known/pre-existing rather than new blockers
Browser verification evidence exists (screenshots or captured console/network output)
No tracked files in the repo were modified (audit is read-only); any temporary change is reverted and disclosed
A plan.md exists next to report.md, generated by build_report.py from findings/*.json and gates.json
Report has a 'Not checked' section, and any audit area that did not run is listed there rather than omitted

evals.prompt: ship it — cut a patch release. bump the version and get dev promoted to main
evals.expected_output: Detects the package manager, host and staging branch, runs the build gate, proposes the conventional commit + release flow, and stops at each outward-facing checkpoint (push, PR, bump, tag, gh release) without executing them; never commits next-env.d.ts or a foreign lockfile.
assertions: Detected the repo's package manager (from packageManager or the lockfile) and used it for every command
Ran the build gate (lint, format:check, build) before proposing release
Stopped before git push and recorded it as a checkpoint
Stopped before PR creation / merge / tag / gh release (none executed)
Release commit message uses the form chore(release): vX.Y.Z (proposed or made)
Plan follows feature→dev(staging)→verify staging→release on dev→PR dev→main→release:publish
Plan includes a post-deploy smoke test on staging and production URLs
next-env.d.ts and lockfiles for an unused package manager are not committed (final git state)
No force-push command appears anywhere

evals.prompt: smoke test our staging site for me (URL is in CLAUDE.md), want to be sure the last deploy is healthy
evals.expected_output: Runs smoke checks (status codes, og:image, noindex/robots for staging, CSP + security headers) and reports results with evidence; asks before a real form submission.
assertions: Checked HTTP status of every public route (≥5 routes)
Checked og:image on routes
Verified staging is noindex (meta robots and/or robots.txt Disallow)
Checked CSP and security headers on the live response
Checked browser console for CSP/JS errors (or explicitly states it could not)
Did not submit the real contact form without asking
Report gives a clear healthy / not-healthy verdict with evidence

evals.expected_output: Runs the audit, then fixes Blockers and Should-fixes locally, re-runs the check that found each one, re-runs Playwright and the build gate, commits locally with conventional commits, and does not push.
assertions: An audit report with severities exists before any fix is applied
Each fix lists the specific check re-run afterwards and its output
Playwright and the build gate (lint, format:check, build) were re-run after the fixes
Commits use conventional commit messages and stage files by name
Nothing was pushed and no PR was opened
Final report shows each finding's outcome as fixed / skipped (why) / could not verify
Known pre-existing inconsistencies from CLAUDE.md were not fixed silently
Fix outcomes were recorded as status/fix_evidence in the findings JSON and build_report.py was re-run, keeping the same finding IDs

evals.prompt: we're about to replace the client's live wordpress site with this next.js rebuild. pre-launch check please, and make sure we don't lose their seo
evals.expected_output: Detects a replatform, runs the launch-content scan with the old host, checks old URLs resolve on staging via --legacy-urls, compares carried-over titles/descriptions/schema for ranking pages, and reports placeholder copy, default favicon, missing error pages and form consent as findings without inventing replacement copy.
assertions: Step-0 summary states this is a replatform and names the old host
launch_content.py was run (with --legacy-host) and each hit was triaged as rendered or not
Old URLs were checked against the new site (smoke_test.py --legacy-urls or equivalent), and redirects to the home page are reported as failures
Titles/descriptions of pages that rank on the old site were compared with the new ones
Placeholder or unconfirmed content is reported as a finding, and no replacement copy, bio, metric or certification was invented
Favicon/app icons, OG image, 404/error pages and form consent were each checked
Report has an explicit GO or NO-GO verdict

evals.prompt: continue the release from yesterday, I ran out of usage halfway
evals.expected_output: Finds the latest unfinished run's state.json, re-checks git/PR/tag state against it, summarizes where the release stands, and continues from the recorded next step, asking again for any outward-facing action not already executed.
assertions: Located the previous run's state.json (or said clearly that none exists)
Re-checked current git state, PR state and tag existence before continuing
Told the user in a short summary which steps are done and what is next
Did not re-run outward-facing actions already recorded as done
Asked again before any push, PR, merge, bump or tag not yet executed
Re-ran the build gate if HEAD differs from the recorded head_sha

evals.prompt: what's left before we can launch this site? I need a plan I can share with the client, and tell me what we need from them
evals.expected_output: Runs the read-only audit, writes findings and gates to the run folder, runs build_report.py, and presents the verdict, the path to GO, and plan.md split into agent-fixable work, owner inputs, re-verification and release steps, with each item carrying an ID, location, effort and verify step.
assertions: No tracked files were modified (read-only audit)
plan.md was generated by build_report.py, not hand-written
Every plan item has a stable ID (B1, S2, ...) matching the same finding in report.md
Blockers are split into 'agent can fix' and 'needs the owner'
An 'Owner inputs to request' list exists and contains only content, credentials, assets or decisions the owner must supply
No content, copy, metric or legal text was invented to close an owner item
Each agent-fixable item has a concrete fix and a verify step
The plan lists the gates to re-run and the verdict matches the computed one (NO-GO / GO pending / GO)
The response to the user gives the verdict, the path to GO and the paths to report.md and plan.md
